name: receipt-print
title: Receipt Print
description: A shop receipt prints out line by line from a printer slot (shop name, items with quantity and price, a dashed rule, the total) and a LUNAS stamp thunks onto it. Items, prices, shop name and total are variables.
useWhen: Showing what a customer bought and that it is paid, in a shop or order confirmation video.
A "lunas" or paid-in-full moment after a list of items.
avoidWhen: A price list for display rather than a bill: use menu-price-board.
A single product price: use price-drop.
A multi-step checkout interface: use checkout-flow.
author: Mosio

source.technique: stamp and stagger: a run of lines printing, then a stamp-and-punch landing

variables.label: Shop name
variables.description: Shop name printed at the top of the receipt.

variables.label: Receipt line
variables.description: Small line with the receipt number, cashier or time. Leave empty to hide it.

variables.label: Items
variables.description: Items separated by semicolons, each as name|quantity|unit price. The line price is quantity times unit price.
variables.default: Kopi susu|2|Rp14.000; Roti bakar|1|Rp12.000; Es teh|1|Rp5.000

variables.label: Total
variables.description: Total shown on the last line. Leave empty to add the item lines up.

variables.label: Footer
variables.description: Line under the total. Leave empty to hide it.

variables.label: Stamp
variables.description: Word stamped on the receipt at the end.

variables.label: Print time
variables.description: Seconds the receipt takes to print out.

variables.label: Receipt font
variables.description: Monospace family for the receipt lines. Geist Mono is loaded by default.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: The LUNAS stamp: the one accent.

variables.label: Font
variables.description: Font family name. Geist is loaded by default; another family must be loaded by the host.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the block sits over your own scene.
